findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "soap-security_soap-security-policy-audit" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Compare WS-Policy and WS-SecurityPolicy assertions across caller-supplied WSDL 1.1 bindings and operations. audit_status is valid, warnings, policy_conflicts, invalid, or incomplete. risk_level is low, medium, high, or critical. A declared policy is not evidence that a server enforces it. Imports ar" → after: "Compare WS-Policy and WS-SecurityPolicy assertions across caller-supplied WSDL 1.1 bindings and operations. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/soap-security/soap-security-policy-audit Keywords: before you expose or call a SOAP service, documents, expected, selection, audit status, audit_status,"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
